descriptionChirho: The proper name Shecaniah/Shekanyah/Shekanyahu, referring to several individuals in post-exilic Israel (priests and Levites in Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah). All four clusters are spelling variants or prepositional forms of the same name. Spanish Secanias/Shekanyahu, Arabic Shakaniya, Hindi shakanYaah, Korean seuganya/syegeomiya, Swahili Shekania. The alternation between -yah and -yahu suffixes is a standard theophoric variant, not a different name.
